title: API & Security Utilities
summary: This module provides core utilities for managing API lifecycle, including beta and deprecation warnings, alongside robust security features for Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection in URL validation and HTTP client requests.

nodes.label: Emit Synchronous Beta Warning
nodes.title: Synchronous Beta Warning Emitter
nodes.description: Wraps synchronous functions to emit a one-time warning when a beta feature is used, ensuring users are aware of experimental functionality without excessive notifications.

nodes.label: Emit Asynchronous Beta Warning
nodes.title: Asynchronous Beta Warning Emitter
nodes.description: Wraps asynchronous functions to emit a one-time warning when a beta feature is used, similar to its synchronous counterpart but for async operations.

nodes.label: Warn on Direct Beta Class Instantiation
nodes.title: Beta Class Instantiation Warning
nodes.description: Intercepts class instantiation to warn users if they directly create an instance of a class marked as beta, promoting awareness of experimental APIs.

nodes.label: Manage Beta Property Access/Modification
nodes.title: Beta Property Access Handler
nodes.description: Handles property access, modification, or deletion for beta features, emitting a warning to indicate that the property is part of an experimental API.

nodes.label: Emit Synchronous Deprecation Warning
nodes.title: Synchronous Deprecation Warning Emitter
nodes.description: Wraps synchronous functions to emit a one-time warning when a deprecated feature is used, guiding users towards newer, supported alternatives.

nodes.label: Emit Asynchronous Deprecation Warning
nodes.title: Asynchronous Deprecation Warning Emitter
nodes.description: Wraps asynchronous functions to emit a one-time warning when a deprecated feature is used, ensuring async code also adheres to deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Warn on Direct Deprecated Class Instantiation
nodes.title: Deprecated Class Instantiation Warning
nodes.description: Intercepts class instantiation to warn users if they directly create an instance of a deprecated class, encouraging migration to current APIs.

nodes.label: Validate URL Against SSRF Policy
nodes.title: SSRF Policy URL Validator
nodes.description: Asynchronously validates a given URL against a defined Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) policy, including DNS resolution to prevent access to restricted IPs.

nodes.label: Check URL for Safety (Non-throwing)
nodes.title: URL Safety Checker
nodes.description: Provides a non-throwing method to check if a URL is safe according to SSRF policies, returning a boolean result for conditional logic.

nodes.label: Strict SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: Strict SSRF Validator
nodes.description: Enforces strict SSRF protection for URLs, disallowing private IP addresses and ensuring secure access to external resources.

nodes.label: HTTPS-Only SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: HTTPS-Only SSRF Validator
nodes.description: Validates URLs for SSRF protection, specifically enforcing the use of HTTPS to ensure encrypted and secure communication channels.

nodes.label: Relaxed SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: Relaxed SSRF Validator
nodes.description: Applies a relaxed SSRF protection policy, allowing access to private IP addresses while still performing other safety checks.

nodes.label: Create SSRF-Protected Async HTTP Client
nodes.title: SSRF-Safe Async HTTP Client Factory
nodes.description: Constructs an `httpx.AsyncClient` instance configured with an SSRF-safe transport, automatically validating all outgoing requests against a security policy.

groups.label: API Lifecycle Management
groups.title: API Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Handles warnings for beta features and deprecated components, ensuring developers are informed about API stability and changes.

groups.label: SSRF Protection & URL Validation
groups.title: SSRF Protection and URL Validation
groups.description: Provides functions to validate URLs against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) policies, preventing malicious requests to internal or restricted resources.

groups.label: Secure Network Transport
groups.title: Secure Network Transport
groups.description: Offers a factory for creating HTTP clients that automatically enforce SSRF protection policies on all outgoing network requests.
